_note: Backend datasets config, committed. Each entry under `datasets` is an alias: `store` is the npm import path of the IDataset class, and `config` is a single JSON object passed verbatim to `new StoreClass(config)`, so its keys are whatever that class's constructor takes. ${VAR} placeholders resolve from the environment (.env or the shell); ${VAR:-default} falls back to the literal after :- when VAR is unset. `main` is the store every shape uses (linked.backend.storage.ts). By default it is FusekiStore on FUSEKI_BASE_URL/FUSEKI_DATASET: `endpoint` is the dataset's URL, `credentials` the Fuseki login. A host may point `main` at a data server instead: "store": "@_linked/server/shapes/quadstores/RemoteDataset" with "config": { "url": "${DATA_SERVER_URL:-}", "token": "${DATA_SERVER_TOKEN_MAIN:-}" }, where `url` is the data server's base URL and `token` the bearer token it issued to this app for that slot. Each further alias (slot) has the same entry with its own token variable, DATA_SERVER_TOKEN_<SLOT> (the slot in upper case).
